description: Runway Gen-4 Image: cinematic images at 720p or 1080p, with up to three tagged reference images to keep people, places or objects consistent. Compared with other image tools: premium. Price: from $0.069 per image, charged only on success. Price depends on resolution: 720p $0.069, 1080p $0.109 (default 1080p). One call = one image.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (https URLs); mention them in the prompt by their tag

reference_tags.description: One tag per reference image, e.g. ["chair"], used in the prompt as @chair

resolution.description: Output resolution; sets the price. Default 1080p

name: runway-gen-4-image
title: Runway Gen-4 Image generation
